prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: reusable category placeholder photograph for a skincare demo catalog.
Primary request: a polished, photorealistic studio product photo of fictional unbranded skincare packaging.
Scene/backdrop: seamless warm off-white studio background and tabletop, close to hex F5F3F0, no horizon line.
Subject: One tall matte porcelain-white facial cleanser pump bottle with a muted sage-green pump head. A simple rounded cylindrical bottle, recognisably a facial wash dispenser.
Composition/framing: exactly one package, centered, entire package and cap visible with generous whitespace on all sides. Object occupies about 65 percent of image height. Square framing. Camera close to front-on with a slight elevated three-quarter view so the top is subtly visible.
Style/medium: realistic commercial skincare still-life photography, crisp package edges, restrained natural material texture, understated and professional.
Lighting/mood: broad soft studio light from upper left, subtle short grounding shadow beneath the object, calm warm neutral tone. No hard dramatic shadows.
Constraints: package is a generic fictional shape, completely blank and label-free. No brand, logo, text, watermark, ingredient claims, SPF numbers, decorative plants, additional objects, hands, people, packaging boxes or floating elements. Single photograph, no collage. Keep the object centered and fully visible.
